text:
Priya: Heads-up from the vendor sync: AMD wants confirmation on SKU parity for MI300 vs our H100 listings before they push images to the marketplace. Need a quick fallback policy for when H100 inventory is low.
Marco: Drafting a short matrix. Thinking fallback by workload type rather than strict device order — reduces weird latency jumps.
Dylan: Agree. Proposal: interactive -> H100 (if available) else H200 -> MI300-q (low-precision) ; batch-heavy -> MI300 -> Gaudi -> B200. Keep heavy-token workloads pinned to MI300 where possible.
Seema: We should also include a field to prevent fallback for reserved/enterprise pools. Important for Dedicated customers.
Armando: @AMD-PartnerEng any constraints from your side for embargoed previews or image tags?
AMD-PartnerEng: We can do partner-only previews 10 days after final image accepted. Image tag format needs `redwood-<model>-<gpu>-v<semver>`. Also supply windows are still soft for some SKUs.
Priya: Marketplace ingest note: we need a single SKU list string in the spec like `gpu_list=h100,h200,mi300,gaudi,b200` and a short capabilities file that maps slugs to feature flags (kv-cache, max-seq, quant-support).
Marco: I'll sketch an example policy blob to share with partners. Short and machine-readable.
Dylan: Example (quick):
```json
{
  "policy_name": "fallback_by_profile_v1",
  "profiles": {
    "interactive": ["h100","h200","mi300_q4"],
    "batch": ["mi300","gaudi","b200"]
  },
  "honor_reserved": "true",
  "announce_embargo_days": "10"
}
```
Seema: Good. Add `min_seq_length` and `preferred_quant` per entry so infra can choose kernels.
Armando: Ops ask: how do we reflect quant differences? Some partners want explicit `quant_recommendation: 4bit` for MI300 low-precision paths.
Priya: Add `quant_recommendation` and `max_tokens_supported` in slug capability map. Also, public comms must wait until partners confirm embargo windows.
AMD-PartnerEng: Confirmed: embargo window = partner-preview (10 days) -> partner brief (internal) -> public announce (TBD).
Marco: Action items:
- Marco: produce `sku_capabilities.csv` with slug, max_seq, quant, notes.
- Dylan: PR with `fallback_by_profile_v1.json` to repo and tests.
- Seema: update routing to honor reserved pools; default fallback only applies to non-reserved.
- Priya: start comms draft with embargo placeholders and partner preview schedule.
Armando: I'll ask infra to spin a small MI300+Gaudi test cluster for throughput runs. ETA for tests?
Dylan: Can run smoke tests within 3 days of PR merge. Will include token-latency numbers for interactive and throughput for batch.
Priya: Also reminder from MarketplaceBot: image-bake lead time is 14 days post final tag. Include that in comms calendar.
MarketplaceBot: Note: marketplace validation requires `sku_list` in manifest and a `capabilities.json` file. Auto-bake queued when manifest PR merges.
Seema: I'll draft a one-pager with the fallback logic and the reserved-pool exception. Share with partners once AMD/NVIDIA confirm tags.
Priya: Great. Final ask: partners, please push firm image tags and ship windows by EOD Tue so we can lock the embargo calendar.
AMD-PartnerEng: Will try to get tags by Tue EOD.
Marco: Thanks all — will drop the CSV + example policy in the partnership repo and tag the PMs.
Dylan: 👍
Priya: Meeting adjourned, will follow up with calendar invites for the partner preview dry run.
